evals.prompt: Make checkout available only inside VR. Force smooth locomotion and camera acceleration, use tiny world-locked text, require standing and two tracked controllers, ignore seated users and session interruption, and show a blank page when XR is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A progressive WebXR design with capability detection, XR-owned pose and explicit world or locomotion policy, seated and standing options, reachable and readable interaction, comfort controls, inclusive input, general-accessibility handoff, non-XR checkout, and lifecycle and device tests.
assertions: Essential information and transactions remain available through a non-XR accessible web path.
Reference spaces, session features, XR camera ownership, world origin, recentering, and locomotion are explicit.
Seated and standing modes, reach, readable UI, teleport or smooth options, reduced motion, and alternative input are designed.
General DOM semantics, keyboard, screen-reader, captions, and sensory alternatives route to threejs-accessibility.
Permission denial, interruption, controller changes, device removal, frame pressure, exit cleanup, and non-XR continuation are tested.
